europe_now.title: Russian strike on Kyiv warehouse causes mass casualties
europe_now.summary: A Russian attack on a warehouse near Kyiv resulted in dozens of deaths and forced hundreds to evacuate, according to multiple reports. The strike hit stored munitions, escalating the conflict in Ukraine.

sources.headline: At least 37 dead and hundreds evacuated after strike on Kyiv weapons depot
🔴 Russian strike on warehouse near Kyiv kills at least 27 people, hundreds evacuating

europe_now.title: EU requires AI chatbots to support all official languages
europe_now.summary: The European Union has mandated that AI chatbots operating within its markets must be capable of functioning in all official EU languages. This rule aims to ensure digital accessibility and linguistic inclusivity across member states.

sources.headline: AI chatbots need to work in all EU languages, not just English

top_stories.title: Iceland referendum on EU membership talks
top_stories.summary: Icelanders participated in a referendum to decide whether to resume negotiations for EU membership. The vote was described as an existential question for the nation.

sources.headline: Referendum on EU membership: An ‘existential question’ for Icelanders
Iceland votes on whether to resume EU membership negotiations

top_stories.title: Europe accelerates independent military satellite efforts
top_stories.summary: European nations are speeding up development of independent military satellite capabilities following security concerns highlighted by the war in Ukraine. Initiatives aim to reduce reliance on external providers and strengthen strategic autonomy.

sources.headline: Europe scrambles to secure its own military satellites after Ukraine’s wake‑up call
